name: Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Universal Scientific Industrial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the design, engineering development, raw material procurement, production, testing, logistics, and after-sales service of electronic products and equipment in Mainland China, the rest of the Asia Pacific, Europe, and internationally.
